cases.name: denies_revoked_before_checking_the_method
cases.note: Revocation short-circuits: a revoked grant denies even for a method it never carried.

cases.name: insertion_order_decides_which_grant_answers
cases.note: The store returns on the first match in insertion order, so an expired grant inserted first denies a request a later live grant would allow. Pinned because a hash map would make it non-deterministic.

cases.name: grant_under_another_token_is_visible_without_a_context
cases.note: Without an authenticated context this store filters on claimant alone. That is why the peer host uses PeerAuthorityHostAuthorizationStore in production and this one only inside a proven session.

cases.name: uncovered_method_reports_no_revision
cases.note: TypeScript raises bestRevision immediately before returning an allow, so the grant_not_found fallback never carries a revision. Pinned as written.
